name: Register Application
user_actions: Enter proposer demographics, age last birthday, gender, occupation, and smoker status; Record applied Sum Assured, policy term, and selected riders; Verify proof of age and note data gaps for follow-up; Call /parties/search to perform party/KYC lookup by identifier or name and date of birth; Call /submissions (POST) to register proposal details, life assured, sum insured, term, and riders; Call /submissions/{id}/validate (POST) to execute mandatory-field and product-rule validations
goal: Capture proposer data and register the individual term life insurance submission in Guidewire PolicyCenter.
key_information: Proposer age, gender, occupation, and smoker status; Applied Sum Assured and policy term; Selected riders (e.g., CI, ADB, WOP); Proof of age; productCode (e.g., MST-2024); proposer partyId; lifeAssured partyId; sumInsured; termYears; premiumMode; riders
data_transformation: Input: Physical or digital proposal form data. Action: Entry and validation of data fields in PolicyCenter. Output: Validated application record queued for assessment.
manual_intervention: Determine if the application has sufficient core information to begin assessment

name: Perform Financial Underwriting
user_actions: Calculate or check Human Life Value based on age and income; Review income proof (ITR or CA-certified financials) based on Sum Assured; Compare applied Sum Assured against the justified HLV amount; Record financial underwriting status or prepare counter-offer; Call /submissions/{id}/financials (GET) to retrieve declared income, proof status, and HLV computations; Call /submissions/{id}/financials/proof (POST) to record the income-proof document reference and verification status; Call /submissions/{id}/financials/hlv (POST) to trigger HLV re-computation against the current Sum Insured
goal: Verify if the applied Sum Assured is financially justified based on the proposer's HLV and income proof.
key_information: Income proof status; Human Life Value limit; ITR (last 3 years) or CA-certified financials; declared income; proof status; HLV computation results; income-proof document reference
data_transformation: Input: Applied Sum Assured and income documentation. Action: Verification against HLV income-multiples. Output: Verified financial underwriting status and HLV-justified amount.
manual_intervention: Determine if declared income and submitted proof justify the requested Sum Assured; Identify if over-insurance presents a moral hazard

name: Determine Medical Requirements
user_actions: Check non-medical limits based on age, Sum Assured, and smoker status; Look up required medical tests in the age x Sum Assured medical grid; Check BMI to trigger additional metabolic panels; Order required medical exams, laboratory tests, or tele-underwriting; Call /underwriting/medical-grid (GET) with age and sumInsured query parameters to lookup required tests; Call /submissions/{id}/medical/tests (POST) to order the required medical tests
goal: Identify standard and additional medical evidence required based on limits, grid, and build.
key_information: Non-medical limits (NML); Medical grid requirements; Proposer build (height, weight, BMI); age band; sumInsured; required tests list
data_transformation: Input: Proposer age, sum assured, smoker status, and build. Action: Application of NML, grid rules, and BMI rules. Output: Ordered medical requirements in PolicyCenter.
manual_intervention: Determine if the proposer is eligible for non-medical underwriting; Determine if disclosures or BMI warrant additional testing beyond the grid
next: Case obviously requires early reinsurer referral->S4; Medical tests are required (standard path)->S5; Proposer is eligible for non-medical acceptance->S7

name: Send Provisional Referral
user_actions: Draft a one-page provisional summary; Transmit provisional details to Atlas Re
goal: Minimise referral latency by notifying Atlas Re early.
key_information: Proposer profile; Referral trigger; Underwriter best-guess rating
data_transformation: Input: Early case details. Action: Underwriter summarizes key details and sends an early alert to Atlas Re. Output: Provisional summary delivered to reinsurer.
manual_intervention: Estimate best-guess rating based on preliminary profile details before medicals return

name: Wait for Medical Results
user_actions: Monitor the status of outstanding medical tests or financial requests; Review incoming reports for completeness
goal: Wait for external third-party administrators, physicians, or proposers to submit medical and financial documents.
key_information: Outstanding medical grid tests status; Incoming medical reports (MER, lab results, ECG/TMT)
data_transformation: Input: Ordered but missing evidence. Action: Retention in assessment queue while awaiting reports. Output: Loaded medical reports and lab results in system.
manual_intervention: Decide whether to follow up or escalate delayed evidence files
wait_for: Wait for external third-party administrators, physicians, or proposers to submit medical and financial documents.
inference_basis: required for continuity; no document states it

name: Record Medical Evidence and Vitals
user_actions: Input Height and Weight; Review auto-calculated BMI; Input Blood pressure; Input Tobacco use; Input MER reference; Input Disclosed medical condition and family history; Add Impairment; Call /submissions/{id}/medical/results (POST) to record MER, lab, and physical vitals results; Call /submissions/{id}/medical/impairments (POST) to add disclosed or discovered impairment records; Call /tele-underwriting/requests (POST) to request a tele-underwriting interview if required; Open Medical Examination Details screen; Review examiner report for height and weight units; Manually check height and weight values; Input height, weight, and validated BMI into PolicyCenter
goal: Capture physical, laboratory, and interview results in the submission profile and verify BMI calculations to bypass auto-calc system defects.
key_information: Height; Weight; BMI; Blood pressure; Tobacco use; Condition; Family history; Lab panel flags; medical examination report (MER); lab results; vitals results; impairment records; Medical examiner report details; Raw height and weight metrics
data_transformation: Input: Clinical exam findings and raw metrics. Action: Underwriter validates measurements, inputs corrected data, and adds impairments. Output: Accurate physical vitals and complete medical profile saved in PolicyCenter.
manual_intervention: Manually evaluate whether calculated BMI is correct if height was reported in feet-and-inches; Determine if a tele-underwriting interview is required to supplement information

name: Review Health Declaration
goal: Assess the self-reported health declaration on non-medical cases.

name: Perform Risk Assessment & Rating
user_actions: Review medical examiner report (MER) findings, physical vitals, and laboratory data; Evaluate occupation class (standard, Class II, hazardous, uninsurable) and avocations; Identify specific medical impairments (e.g., diabetes, hypertension); Aggregate extra mortality (EM) loading based on combined risk factors; Review rating engine suggested EM; Enter/override EM rating; Enter override reason; Call /submissions/{id}/rating/evaluate (POST) to invoke the automated rating engine; Call /submissions/{id}/rating/override (POST) if a manual extra mortality (EM) override with optional reason is needed
goal: Evaluate suggested mortality ratings and apply overrides for complex or aggregate risks.
key_information: Medical reports and lab results (HbA1c, lipids, BP); Occupation and lifestyle details; Indicative extra mortality (EM) rating scales; Rating engine output premium; Rating engine suggested EM; Underwriter override; Override reason; suggested extra mortality (EM); premium details; manual override EM value
data_transformation: Input: Medical and financial risk profile. Action: Analysis of risk factors, automated rating, and optional manual override of EM rating. Output: Core mortality rating with finalized EM% loading.
manual_intervention: Determine risk loading percentage (EM) for substandard factors; Assess whether combined impairments require joint consideration instead of simple addition; Determine if multiple rateable factors require a higher aggregate rating rather than a mechanical sum; Check for moral hazard patterns (e.g. concurrent applications with other insurers)
next: Case requires reinsurance referral->S9; Case does not require reinsurance referral->S11

name: Raise Reinsurance Referral
user_actions: Confirm if referral triggers (such as sum assured, EM > 150%, or hazardous occupation) are met; Draft a concise referral note with specific questions and medical/financial summary; Submit case details and files to the Chief Underwriting Officer or Atlas Re; Click Raise Referral; Select Reinsurer; Submit case terms and override reasons; Call /reinsurance/treaty-limits (GET) to check configured automatic retention and acceptance limits; Call /reinsurance/referrals (POST) to dispatch a facultative referral to the configured reinsurer
goal: Escalate high-risk or high-value cases to ceding reinsurers or Chief Underwriting Officer for facultative review.
key_information: Referral triggers (Sum Assured, aggregate EM, occupation); Underwriter provisional assessment; Referral note template; Referred to; Override reason; Aggregate EM; reinsurance referral id; configured retention and automatic acceptance limits
data_transformation: Input: Completed file with referral triggers. Action: Compiling note and electronic dispatch of referral package. Output: Dispatched referral record in system.
manual_intervention: Determine the appropriate referral destination (CUO or Atlas Re) based on triggers

name: Wait for Reinsurance Response
user_actions: Monitor status of external or internal referral queries; Review confirmed reinsurer conditions or CUO sign-off; Call /reinsurance/referrals/{id} (GET) to query referral status and obtain reinsurer's response
goal: Await response and confirmed underwriting terms from the Chief Underwriting Officer or reinsurer.
key_information: Reinsurer response / confirmed terms; CUO escalation feedback; referral status and reinsurer response
data_transformation: Input: Pending referred case. Action: Case hold in queue. Output: Approved reinsurer/internal terms stored against case.
manual_intervention: Decide if follow-up with Atlas Re or internal leads is required to reduce referral latency
wait_for: Await response and confirmed underwriting terms from the Chief Underwriting Officer or reinsurer.
inference_basis: required for continuity; no document states it

name: Record Underwriting Decision
user_actions: Select Decision; Confirm reinsurer terms; Call /submissions/{id}/decision (POST) to save standard, rated-up, postponed, or declined decision status
goal: Confirm and record the final underwriting risk disposition in Guidewire PolicyCenter.
key_information: Decision; Reinsurer terms; underwriting decision (Standard, Rated-up, Postpone, or Decline)
data_transformation: Input: Rating, manual overrides, and reinsurer response. Action: Selection of decision type and commit to system. Output: Finalized decision status stored against the submission.
manual_intervention: Formulate final rating decision after reinsurer confirmation; Decide proposal risk disposition based on financial, medical, rating, and reinsurer evaluations
next: Decision is Standard or Rated-up->S12; Decision is Postpone or Decline->S14

name: Issue Offer
user_actions: Click Issue Offer; Call /submissions/{id}/offer (POST) to issue a standard offer; Call /submissions/{id}/counter-offer (POST) to submit a revised counter-offer
goal: Issue the finalized standard or rated-up insurance offer to the distribution channel.
key_information: Annual premium; Rating; Riders; revised Sum Insured; revised term; revised riders
data_transformation: Input: Approved underwriting terms. Action: Generation and transmission of standard offer or counter-offer details. Output: Offer or counter-offer dispatched to the channel.
manual_intervention: Determine whether to proceed with a standard offer or issue a revised counter-offer (revised Sum Insured, term, or riders)

name: Wait for Customer Response
goal: Wait for the proposer to accept or reject the issued offer and terms.
key_information: Offer status; proposer response (acceptance, rejection, or non-response)
data_transformation: Input: Proposer feedback. Action: System waits for proposer response and records the decision. Output: Updated offer status.
wait_for: Wait for the proposer to accept or reject the issued offer and terms.
next: Proposer accepts offer->S15; Proposer rejects or does not respond->S14
inference_basis: required for continuity; no document states it

name: Close Case
user_actions: Call /submissions/{id}/close (POST) to officially close the case with a corresponding reason code; Wave through, approve, or decline the application in the closing screen
goal: Finalize case closure when declined, not-taken-up (NTU), or rejected.
key_information: submission case status (issued / NTU / declined / rejected); close reason code
data_transformation: Input: Close reason code and status. Action: Case status updated and deactivated in system. Output: Closed submission case record.

name: Issue Policy
user_actions: Click Issue Policy; Call /policies (POST) to issue the active policy from an accepted submission
goal: Finalize policy closure and trigger core policy issuance.
data_transformation: Input: Accepted offer record. Action: Policy generation rules are executed and core policy is issued. Output: Issued active policy in the system.
manual_intervention: Confirm if all pre-closing quality control checks are satisfied
